subject: Partnering to establish Diablo Sugar Free in the {{market_short}} sugar free snacks landscape
body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I'm writing from the office of the Strategy Director at Diablo Sugar Free, where I look after international partners.

By way of introduction, we are the largest sugar-free confectionery company in Europe. Chocolate bars and boxed chocolates, biscuits, wafers, sweets, spreads and jams, eleven categories in all. As you'll know, sugar-free carries a better margin than standard confectionery, because the shopper accepts a higher price point. We supply more than 126 countries and are listed with Carrefour, Lidl, Tesco and Holland & Barrett.

{{personal_line}}

Attaching a catalogue for your reference: {{catalogue_link}}

We would be more than glad to set up a call between your team and our outreach or strategy team leads, so we can look at what the range would need to earn properly for your professional customers.

Let us know what day and time suits your team's schedule. Or if you would want to set up a call directly, you can do it from the link below.
{{booking_link}}

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
{{sender_title}}
Diablo Sugar Free
{{sender_website}}
{{sender_phone}}


Diablo Sugar Free (B Healthy Ltd, London)
We found your business details in public and commercial sources. If you would rather not hear from us, reply "no thanks" and we will not contact you again.
